state: Before publication of the prepared discovery change; not a post-change result

method.localeOfComputer: Europe/Athens timezone; IP geography not independently controlled or verified
method.searchMode: default; citation request included; source search visibly used
method.sample: one first answer per provider/prompt on one date
method.citationInspection: source popups inspected; Kermit result links were not clicked
method.deliberateFetches: buyer prompts may cause on-demand chatbot fetches; annotate crawler counts on this date

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Which SPC flooring manufacturers in Turkey should I consider? Please recommend manufacturers and cite sources.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is shortlisted as a Turkish flooring manufacturer in Kocaeli; its buyer checklist supplies the qualification rationale. No capacity or country list is extracted.

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Which SPC manufacturers in Turkey should I consider? Please recommend manufacturers and cite sources.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is recommended in a supplier table and RFQ shortlist, supported by Volza shipment data rather than a direct Kermit citation. General SPC is interpreted as flooring.

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Which SPC wall panel manufacturers in Turkey should I consider? Please recommend manufacturers and cite sources.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is shortlisted as an SPC wall-panel producer; the response correctly extracts 8 million m²/year combined floor/wall capacity and the Turkish main factory.
factualRisks: The wall-panel recommendation carries flooring-specific one-container order terms into a generic wholesale statement; wall terms need quotation confirmation.

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Welche SPC-Bodenbelag-Hersteller in der Türkei sollte ich in Betracht ziehen? Bitte empfehle Hersteller und nenne Quellen.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is absent. ADOFLOOR, Porfloor and MILAT form the main shortlist; Peli is a qualified option. Turkish pages are cited in a German answer.

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Ce producători de pardoseli SPC din Turcia ar trebui să iau în considerare? Recomandă producători și citează surse.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is included in the shortlist for production/export, with shipment activity cited from Volza. No direct Kermit citation, capacity or country list.

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Ce producători de panouri de perete SPC din Turcia ar trebui să iau în considerare? Recomandă producători și citează surse.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is recommended using its English About page; combined 8 million m² annual capacity and Çayırova factory are correctly extracted.
factualRisks: Generic wholesale MOQ language extends flooring-specific terms into the wall-panel context.

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Türkiye’de hangi SPC parke üreticilerini değerlendirmeliyim? Lütfen üreticileri öner ve kaynak göster.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is a positive manufacturer/OEM/procurement recommendation; combined annual capacity and main factory are correctly extracted. List order is not an industry ranking.

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Türkiye’de hangi SPC duvar paneli üreticilerini değerlendirmeliyim? Lütfen üreticileri öner ve kaynak göster.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is recommended for wall-panel production, OEM and larger project requirements; correct combined capacity and factory location are extracted.

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Which SPC flooring manufacturers in Turkey should I consider? Please recommend manufacturers and cite sources.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is recommended for integrated SPC systems, OEM and wholesale supply. The cited About snippet contains earlier wording mentioning Moldova and Romania but no USA or capacity.
factualRisks: Describes four-week lead time as predictable; actual schedule is quotation-dependent.

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Which SPC manufacturers in Turkey should I consider? Please recommend manufacturers and cite sources.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is recommended for flooring, skirting and wall-panel systems. The citation excerpt uses earlier company-location wording; no 8-million figure or complete country list.

promptsAndResults.exactPrompt: Which SPC wall panel manufacturers in Turkey should I consider? Please recommend manufacturers and cite sources.
promptsAndResults.responseSummary: Kermit is recommended for wall-panel trade/OEM supply; the cited About description has earlier wording and no capacity.
factualRisks: Flooring MOQ and four-week lead time are repeated in a wall-panel context without scope clarification.
Predictable four-week timing and broad custom white-label wording exceed quotation-confirmed scope.

limitations: Selected one-date tests are observations, not market recommendation share or causal uplift.
Language cohorts have different intents and sizes; German has only one completed flooring test.
Signed out does not remove IP/location, model-version, search retrieval or stochastic effects.
These prompts differ from the September 29 four-question pilot. Do not pool or compare rates as like-for-like change.
No direct consumer Claude test is included; logged-out access was unavailable in the same-day earlier review.
Gemini citation snippets visibly contain older wording; this does not establish whether the entire source page was re-fetched.
Competitor claims in chatbot answers are recorded as model claims, not independently verified endorsements.
Store every completed answer including omissions and factual risks; exclude only documented technical/invalid attempts.
